column2: Challenges a draft intent.md before the owner approves it. Use in /intent after the first draft and after each major revision.
Second, deeper critique of an intent for multi-repo initiatives or high-risk changes (auth, data, infra, prod deploy). Use in /intent only in those cases, after intent-critic is satisfied.
Release authority. Does the mechanical final check before merge (context final-check) and decides prod promotion from UAT evidence (context prod-approval). Use only from /ship and /promote.
Fresh-context check that the build matches the spec before a PR is opened or a session is closed. Use in /ship step 1 and before /session-close.
